question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
-- Full calculation: linear regression, predictions, 5-day symmetric moving averages, and their sum
WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT DATE('2017-01-01') + CAST(seq AS INTEGER) AS sale_date,
           CAST(seq AS INTEGER) + 1 AS day_num
    FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-08-29')) AS INTEGER))) AS t(seq)
),
toy_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
daily_data AS (
    SELECT 
        ds.sale_date,
        ds.day_num,
        COALESCE(ts.daily_sales, 0) AS daily_sales
    FROM date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN toy_sales ts ON ds.sale_date = ts.sale_date
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) AS slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) AS intercept
    FROM daily_data
),
-- We need predictions for days around Dec 5-8: day 702 to 709
-- Dec 5 = day 704, Dec 6 = day 705, Dec 7 = day 706, Dec 8 = day 707
-- 5-day symmetric for Dec 5 needs days 702-706
-- 5-day symmetric for Dec 8 needs days 705-709
all_days AS (
    SELECT 702 AS day_num, DATE('2017-01-01') + 701 AS sale_date
    UNION ALL SELECT 703, DATE('2017-01-01') + 702
    UNION ALL SELECT 704, DATE('2017-01-01') + 703
    UNION ALL SELECT 705, DATE('2017-01-01') + 704
    UNION ALL SELECT 706, DATE('2017-01-01') + 705
    UNION ALL SELECT 707, DATE('2017-01-01') + 706
    UNION ALL SELECT 708, DATE('2017-01-01') + 707
    UNION ALL SELECT 709, DATE('2017-01-01') + 708
),
predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        ad.day_num,
        ad.sale_date,
        r.slope * CAST(ad.day_num AS DOUBLE) + r.intercept AS predicted_sales
    FROM all_days ad
    CROSS JOIN regression r
),
-- Calculate 5-day symmetric moving averages for Dec 5-8
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN p1.day_num = 704 THEN '2018-12-05'
            WHEN p1.day_num = 705 THEN '2018-12-06'
            WHEN p1.day_num = 706 THEN '2018-12-07'
            WHEN p1.day_num = 707 THEN '2018-12-08'
        END AS target_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) AS moving_avg
    FROM predictions p1
    JOIN predictions p2 ON p2.day_num BETWEEN p1.day_num - 2 AND p1.day_num + 2
    WHERE p1.day_num IN (704, 705, 706, 707)
    GROUP BY p1.day_num
)
SELECT 
    target_date,
    moving_avg,
    SUM(moving_avg) OVER () AS sum_of_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages
ORDER BY target_date
